title: Unbelievably Garlicky Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic Turkish dish featuring lamb, garlic, and lemon zest, perfect for satisfying midnight cravings. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe uses fry-grind-rice-khao-khua for added texture.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine lamb cubes, minced garlic, lemon zest, olive oil, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Thread the lamb mixture onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar and khao khuah powder.
Brush the kebabs with the vinegar mixture during the last minute of grilling.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional lemon zest if desired.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve with a side of fry-grind-rice-khao-khua for a satisfying snack.
